narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>Four divides a number when its last digit is zero, four or eight.
<bookmark mark='look'/>But look again, because twelve and sixteen are multiples of four too.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>They end in two and six, so those endings can belong to multiples of four.

narration: <bookmark mark='rule'/>Two numbers can end in the same digit, and four can divide only one of them.
<bookmark mark='turn'/>Your turn. Does four divide twenty six? Does four divide thirty six?
